description: This is a React TSX source file implementing the main application component for a persona builder interface. It includes state management, file upload handling, dynamic UI updates, and user interactions such as editing persona details, uploading documents, and navigating between different personas states.

methods.name: validateFile
methods.description: Validates if the uploaded file has an allowed extension (.pdf, .docx, .txt).

methods.name: handleFileChange
methods.description: Handles the change event of the file input, adding selected files after validation.

methods.name: addFiles
methods.description: Adds new files to the uploadedFiles state after validating count and formats.

methods.name: handleDrop
methods.description: Handles files dropped into the upload area, adding them via addFiles().

methods.name: handleDragOver
methods.description: Prevents default behavior to allow drop event to trigger.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a file from the uploaded files list given its ID.

methods.name: handleGenerateDraft
methods.description: Simulates generating a draft persona by setting processing state and then moving to 'draft'.

methods.name: handleSaveChanges
methods.description: Saves persona changes and provides user feedback.

methods.name: handleFinalize
methods.description: Finalizes the persona and disables editing.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a skill from the persona's skill list.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the persona's skill list.

methods.name: handleProfileImageChange
methods.description: Handles changing of the profile image by reading the selected file and updating state.

methods.name: removeExperience
methods.description: Removes an experience entry by its ID.

methods.name: getFileType
methods.description: Returns a string representing the file extension type in uppercase.
